scientific_change: No objective or controller change from trial004. Continue its predesignated final checkpoint for exactly 600 additional PPO updates to control for the continuation workflow used by trial010.
hypothesis: Continued optimization alone may change tracking and transfer performance. An unchanged-objective continuation is needed before attributing trial010 failure to its additional ground-load reward. Outcome unknown; this single-seed control does not establish causality or statistical robustness.
activation_prerequisites: Failed trial010 full four-panel publication is preserved at Git commit c7c66eaac7b52d74ca2968d469d13e31f0acb323; all eight publication artifact hashes are guarded before launch.
Original trial004 final checkpoint, completed status, manifest, original task profile and PPO runner configuration hashes match before launch.
Root reviews and freezes this protocol, unchanged source commit and deployment archive before any training process is created.
Fresh GPU5 UUID/idle guard and existing unmasked native PhysX/Torch/tensor device audit; no other-user job or device fallback.
Actual original 500/10 gains and 0.15 robot/ground friction readback are verified by the unchanged production entrypoint before learning.

training.iteration_label_semantics: Installed runner ranges from loaded iteration 3996 through 4595 inclusive: 600 actual updates. Repeated initial iteration label is bookkeeping, not a missing update.
training.checkpoint_selection: Predesignated model_final.pt after all 600 updates; no intermediate-best selection, extra updates, reward/gain/LR changes or selection after evaluation.
training.actuator_domain_randomization: Existing motor-v1 shaft-friction, motor-speed and motor-torque distributions unchanged; no contact/mass/gravity randomization.
training.failure_policy: Preserve startup/runtime/training failures and raw records. Incomplete learning or a timeout is not a final trained-policy evaluation. No automatic budget, source or device change.

resume_semantics_preserved.optimizer_restoration: Unchanged OnPolicyRunner.load(load_optimizer=True): restore original Adam moments, parameter-step counters and parameter-group LR; preserve existing scalar-LR resume behavior, not a simultaneous repair.
resume_semantics_preserved.normalization: Restore original actor/critic normalization buffers and counts, then keep their original train-mode updates with until=None; no reset or freeze.
resume_semantics_preserved.environment: Fresh environment and original eight zero-action startup steps/reset before load; environment, motion-sampler and RNG continuation state are not checkpoint-restored.

evaluation.conditions: Nominal motors; original reference frame zero and initial velocities; no extra lateral reset velocity, hidden root writes or controller diagnostic override.
evaluation.recording: Full actual 200 Hz first-episode state/contact evidence in both engines and unchanged 50 Hz actor observations/actions.
evaluation.acceptance: All original assess_drift.py gates unchanged: at least 0.20 s uninterrupted speed>=0.4 m/s, positive forward component, abs(beta)>=8 degrees, both actual bearing wheel-ground contacts and mean contact-patch lateral slip>=0.04 m/s, plus every original tracking/support/nonwheel/full-duration/stable-stop gate. No gap bridging.
evaluation.provenance: Fresh final011 checkpoint, exact exported weights/normalizer against that checkpoint, actual same actor file between engines and independent recorded-action/observation replay. A learned011 actor is not required to equal the original004 actor.
evaluation.diagnostics: Compare004-to011 continuation-only changes against004-to010 continuation-plus-objective changes. Existing archived normal-force vectors are not claimed to reconstruct a bit-exact ground-load reward.
evaluation.format: Captured car -> TRON1 kinematic reference -> Isaac policy -> MuJoCo same policy; full four-panel video, contact timeline and all failed gates. Preserve initial jump animation and all previous publications.
evaluation.interpretation: One predeclared continuation control. No causal law, hardware readiness, global stability, statistical robustness or sim2sim-success claim before assessment.

resources.mode: One authorized owned application; fresh pinned GPU5 idle guard, no CUDA mask, unchanged optional native-device readback.
resources.budget: 4500 s timeout sends TERM then KILL after 30 s; exception cleanup signals only the newly owned process group.
resources.launch_evidence: Exclusive fresh launch receipt and log reserved and receipt durably written before Popen; separate immutable started/exit records preserve actual owned PID and outcome.
resources.cross_gpu_contexts: All owned CUDA context rows may be recorded; non-target contexts are not claimed absent or harmless. Idle checks are not an atomic GPU reservation.
resources.other_users_jobs: Never terminated or altered; no automatic alternate GPU or resource expansion.
